claims: C1 in ChatGPT and OpenAI's other first-party products, developers may also play a role by creating third-party extensions such as custom GPTs
C2 in these products, OpenAI may also sometimes play the role of developer
C3 OpenAI always represents the root/system in these products

concepts.name: first_party_product
concepts.gloss: a product that is one of OpenAI's own first-party products, such as ChatGPT

concepts.name: third_party_extension
concepts.gloss: a third-party extension such as a custom GPT, created by a developer for use within a first-party product

concepts.name: plays_developer_role
concepts.gloss: entity E plays the role of developer in product P

concepts.name: represents_root_system
concepts.gloss: entity E represents the root/system in product P

concepts.name: created_extension
concepts.gloss: developer D created third-party extension E

concepts.name: openai
concepts.gloss: the entity OpenAI, the company operating the first-party products

concepts.name: developer_definition
concepts.gloss: a customer of the OpenAI API who may add intelligence to software applications or create natural language interfaces consumed by end users

ontology.gloss: a developer plays the developer role in a first-party product by creating a third-party extension for it
OpenAI sometimes plays the developer role in a first-party product
OpenAI always represents the root/system in a first-party product
